contentText: For eight years, he’s been a mainstay among European leaders, one who’s snatched victory from the jaws of defeat before but has Pedro Sanchez run out of road this time? Spain's Socialist prime minister dogged by incumbent fatigue and nepotism allegations. Sanchez gambled on turning the rift in his coalition over his country's housing shortage into a referendum on his country's strong growth and calling a snap general election.
